opportunities.name: Warpath speed conversion
opportunities.objective: Turn a timed movement burst into physical charge and cleave damage.
opportunities.mechanic: Warpath converts a level-dependent portion of bonus speed to AD; Devastating Charge increases speed from 25% to 65% and its physical damage depends on distance traveled. Youmuu and Dead Man's Plate create a timed entry, Trinity rewards the charge attack, and Shojin supports stacked Rampage afterward. W healing rewards damage actually dealt nearby.
opportunities.requiredState: Need a long entry path, movement effects active and a target reachable before E ends.
opportunities.failure: CC or cramped paths cut distance; speed items without health make the first impact fragile.
opportunities.test: Compare E and three-stack Q damage with speed effects active versus expired, recording actual bonus AD.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Movement-speed soft caps and decay prevent treating listed percentages as unlimited additive AD.

opportunities.name: Spectral AP drain dive
opportunities.objective: Test magic R/W damage while preserving the drain window.
opportunities.mechanic: Onslaught of Shadows has 1 AP magic damage and distance-scaled fear; Spirit of Dread has 0.8 AP over four seconds and heals from Hecarim and nearby allied damage. Liandry and Abyssal support magic pressure, Visage supports received healing, and Rocketbelt helps keep W in contact after the entry. Rampage retains only its native AD loop.
opportunities.requiredState: Need grouped nearby targets and allies damaging enemies inside W's four-second window.
opportunities.failure: Low Q damage and short W duration can lose an extended duel; enemies scatter after fear.
opportunities.test: Compare R/W damage and healing separately from Q over one dive with and without allied follow-up.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: AP does not directly strengthen Rampage; W does not heal from allies damaging remote enemies.

ruledOut.reason: Q has an AD statFormula expression, not an AP ratio; AP builds need W/R contact to pay off.

unknowns: Warpath's speed-stat expression and W damage-source healing eligibility need live checks; preserve raw formula flags.

builds.name: Warpath speed conversion
builds.summary: Turn a timed movement burst into physical charge and cleave damage.
builds.goal: Turn a timed movement burst into physical charge and cleave damage.
builds.hypothesis: Warpath converts a level-dependent portion of bonus speed to AD; Devastating Charge increases speed from 25% to 65% and its physical damage depends on distance traveled. Youmuu and Dead Man's Plate create a timed entry, Trinity rewards the charge attack, and Shojin supports stacked Rampage afterward. W healing rewards damage actually dealt nearby.
testPlan: Required state: Need a long entry path, movement effects active and a target reachable before E ends.
Compare E and three-stack Q damage with speed effects active versus expired, recording actual bonus AD.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: CC or cramped paths cut distance; speed items without health make the first impact fragile.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Movement-speed soft caps and decay prevent treating listed percentages as unlimited additive AD.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Youmuu's Ghostblade, Dead Man's Plate, Trinity Force, Spear of Shojin, Death's Dance, Boots of Swiftness. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
